ITEM 1 | Small round-to-oval grains, golden-brown to tan with darker brown specks, matte surface, slightly firm and separate, clustered in a mound about 7 cm across and 1.5 cm high on the left side of the plate, with a few dark flecks mixed in | 75
ITEM 2 | Cauliflower florets, pale cream-yellow with slightly mottled surface, firm and dry-looking, several clustered florets about 4 to 5 cm across and 2 cm high, some broken into smaller pieces, placed in the center-left of the plate | 85
ITEM 3 | Watermelon cubes, bright red-pink flesh with a moist, glossy look, cut into roughly 2 to 3 cm chunks, scattered around the right side of the plate over the greens, about 2 cm high | 110
ITEM 4 | Mixed salad greens, dark green and purple-red leaves with lighter pale green pieces, slightly wilted and glossy, spread across the center and right of the plate in a layer about 1 cm high, with a few light green strands | 60
ITEM 5 | Small crumbled white pieces, pale off-white and soft-looking, scattered in small bits about 0.5 to 1 cm among the greens and near the watermelon | 8
ITEM 6 | Thin dark red strip, reddish-brown with a slightly shiny surface, about 3 cm long and 0.5 cm wide, lying near the top of the grains | 3
